title: Filtered colimits of abelian higher direct images
statement: Let h:Y to X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes, q an integer, and J a small filtered category. The functor from abelian etale sheaves on Y to those on X, taking F to H^q(R^+h_*(F[0])), preserves colimits of shape J [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

source.place: Tag 0F1I, lemma-punctual-base-change, degree-zero and bounded-exponent reductions; Tag 073E, filtered colimits

proof.text: Integral module forgetting is an equivalence on coefficient categories (the canonical integer action), and hence on sheaves. Single-complex and homology comparison isomorphisms and the derived direct-image coefficient comparison identify integral higher direct image followed by forgetting with forgetting followed by abelian higher direct image.

Integral module higher direct image preserves filtered colimits. Transfer preservation through the two coefficient equivalences using the natural comparison; their quasi-inverses preserve all colimits.
